snippet.title: RUMBRAL — Official Release Date Trailer | April 23
snippet.description:
RUMBRAL launches April 23 on PC (Steam & Epic), PlayStation 5, Xbox and Nintendo Switch.

Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3565040/Rumbral/

---

You wake up in a world that doesn’t explain itself.

RUMBRAL is an atmospheric exploration game built around tension, discovery and player interpretation. Explore a forgotten world, solve environmental puzzles and shift between parallel realities to uncover what really happened.

No exposition. No noise. Just observation and discovery.

---

FEATURES

• Explore a mysterious world with no guidance  
• Solve environmental puzzles integrated into the environment  
• Shift between parallel realities to progress  
• Reconstruct the story through scattered fragments  
• A quiet, tension-driven experience  

---

AVAILABLE APRIL 23

PC (Steam & Epic)  
PlayStation 5  
Xbox  
Nintendo Switch  

---

Follow RUMBRAL:

Twitter: https://x.com/PlayRumbral  
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/playrumbral/  

---

Published by DOJO System  
Developed by OSEAIn
